title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode9 New Sights

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're done warming up, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's continue where we left off last time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's go all out right from the start!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Th-They're amazing singers...!
I'm getting goosebumps!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Kohane and them are working super hard to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! They're really motivated now after their recent trip to the United States!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, wow...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The world. Hehe...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (They're just like Tsukasa and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bravo!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was some incredible singing...!
I can see how you all surpassed that legendary event!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
Did you come over to watch us practice?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seem different from normal...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Oh, is it because she's wearing a new outfit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, she is...
Are you holding an event today or something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An event? No, nothing in particular!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Then, what's going on here...?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She seems like a completely different person instead of just different from normal...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you're sharp!
That's right! I'm MEIKO from a different SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
MEIKO from a different SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, how's that even possible...?!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. It's the truth!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Rin! Len!
We didn't see you two there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But are you really from a different SEKAI, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! I understand why you're all surprised!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was startled too when I arrived in this SEKAI! I couldn't figure out what had happened!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I got to meet all of you, listen to your wonderful singing...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And have delicious food that my counterpart made. I've been having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sh-She really is different from the MEIKO we know...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Still, you're all so incredible.
You surpassed that legendary event, made your dream a reality...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And now, you're aiming to stand on top of the world, yes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Currently, we're practicing to accomplish our next goal, which is to win a tournament over in the United States.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A tournament? Wow!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck to you all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The climb between us and the top of the world is probably steeper than we realize.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There will be lots we have to learn, and a lot of things we'll have to sort out. I don't think it'll be easy for us at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we want to put on performances that make people from all around the world go absolutely wild...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then we need to win that tournament no matter what!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not like this is the first super-high wall we've ever faced, though.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We're standing here right now because we found ways to overcome them all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The four of us are gonna stand on top of the world. No matter what.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
A steep climb to the top of the world...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well then, the view from up there must be incredible!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'd also love to experience that...
Can you imagine what you're going to see from up there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm... We really don't know yet...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. Only those who worked very hard to make the climb get to see that view, so it's not so easy to imagine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This SEKAI also has a big wall, doesn't it?
You might be able to experience something similar by climbing on top of it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, since we're all here, let's climb it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Climb it...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't mean...literally climb this wall, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course I do! This wall's so tall that you should be able to see all of this SEKAI from on top of it, no?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But are you sure about this?
There's a big hole in the middle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess you could climb on top it as long as you avoided that part.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
B-But how are you gonna climb it...?
It's so tall...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? That's easy!
Watch!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! She's wall jumping...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is like something straight out of an action movie...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She climbed that big wall like it was nothing. I didn't realize you could achieve such a body by doing shows...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Meanwhile, those four seem completely stunned...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There we are...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She really climbed it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, umm... Now what?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, there's way we can climb it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Amazing!
So this is what this SEKAI looks like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Hurry and join me, everyone!
The view from up here is spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But there's no way we can climb it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Oh? In that case...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
This rope should do the trick!
I'll pull you all up as you climb!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Using that rope...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I just saw some things over there that might work well as cushions!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's go grab them, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! We'll be right back, you guys!
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I might try climbing it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I want to see what it's like from up there. And it should be safe with her pulling me up, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm also a bit curious...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to see as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But using just this rope seems...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Aren't you coming?
The view from up here really is amazing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, Toya, you wait here while we look for a better way to climb up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
We'll scout ahead and take a look...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry...
se_run_men_001_2
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You guys!
We got those cushions!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks! Then, let's start.
Up we go.
se_event_wl_2nd_piapro_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Climbing this might be easier than I thought.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How are you doing, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good, I think...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You guys got this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But don't push yourselves too hard!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, but we should be fine!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Just a little further!
Keep it up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Suddenly feels like we're doing after-school sports here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we're almost there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Just another meter or so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
L-Look...
The building in front of us has a big rooftop.
se_event_wl_2nd_piapro_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi might be able to use the bit protruding from the wall to climb up here, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that might work.
You two go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Think you can get up here, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll pull you up, so just keep climbing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I made it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That makes all four of you.
Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we're glad that you were able to join us, Toya! I thought it'd be pretty rough for you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have Shinonome to thank for pulling you up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to without MEIKO's help. You feeling okay, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... The ground being so far down is a little unnerving, but I should be fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, take a look!
This is what the view is like from on top of SEKAI's wall!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The view...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, this is amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This city just seems to go on forever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...!
That area looks a lot like where we visited in the US.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that skyline over there looks totally unfamiliar. It'd be nice to sing there someday.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. Standing on top of the world means making streets all across the globe rumble.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After you win that tournament and overcome each new wall all under your own power, you might get to see more new sights.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
We'll have to keep working at it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So that we can keep seeing new things!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
I feel like we've been given a nice push.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we're gonna need to keep growing, since we have some really tough rivals now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and we can't afford to lose to anyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll all do just fine!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After all, your powerful desire to see the world beyond this wall got you up here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, we promise to do our best!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Their smiles are shining even brighter now...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was a little worried about show performer me since she is a bit reckless...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But who she is as a person allowed her to show them this view.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, me!
